rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill, because it has `name` and `description` front matter. It is therefore a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. No violation matches were listed for it.

The requirement says a skill MAY link to files for specialized material. Each such link MUST say when to read the file.

- **Markdown link:** The only real Markdown link is `[CI example](../habeas/references/ci.md)` in workflow step 9. It sits in the sentence "Recommend separate successful collection and `habeas coverage-check` steps in project CI, using the Habeas CI example". That ties the file to a stated situation: recommending CI steps in the final report. I read this as saying when to consult it.
- **Code-span file pointers:** The skill also points to other skills' files in code spans, which are not links. Each one carries its own trigger:
  - `references/authoring-failures.md`: read it if `habeas author --stdout` fails.
  - `references/distributed-requirements.md`: read it when a convention applies on its own at many sites.
  - `references/fixme.md`: read it when the user defers a possible bug.

No link lacks a "when to read" condition, so I found no gap.
